description: Checkout API returned elevated HTTP 5xx errors in production us-east-1.
issue_summary: At capture, 7.8% of checkout-api requests returned 5xx errors; failing traces first point to inventory-service.
trigger_summary: The 7.8% 5xx rate was above the documented 3% threshold. The alert requires this rate to remain above 3% for 5 minutes; this snapshot does not include the time series needed to independently verify that duration.
trace_summary: Failing traces identify inventory-service as the first failing span. checkout-api has no new deployment in the incident window.
